video_title: Darius Acuff Jr. Talks Rookie Mindset, Teammate Advice & Life in Sacramento at Kings Media Day

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on building chemistry with Domantas Sabonis
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to get some layups off him. He can pass too.
quotes.quote: It's been great. A couple of five-on-five sessions we were on the same team and it was easy to play with him. I'm going to get some layups off him. He can pass too. It's great building chemistry with him. It's very exciting for sure.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on his leadership role as a point guard
quotes.excerpt: As the point guard you got to lead the team. That's how y'all going to win.
quotes.quote: I'd say just staying level-headed and being smart and just being a leader. As the point guard you got to lead the team. That's how y'all going to win. Just getting everybody where they need to be, everybody taking accountability no matter who you is. Being together as a team on and off the court is going to help on the court for sure.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on playing in Domantas Sabonis's system
quotes.excerpt: I like throwing pocket passes and short passes. I'm good with that.
quotes.quote: I like throwing pocket passes and short passes. I'm good with that. I think it's pretty much the same as lobs to me. I'm comfortable with throwing both. He has a great touch around the rim so it'll be good.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on Mike Brown's ability to coach point guards
quotes.excerpt: It seems like every year he got somebody new. He coaches the best point guards.
quotes.quote: I was talking to somebody yesterday. I don't know how he does it. It seems like every year he got somebody new. Even this year he got somebody, next year he might get some. It's just crazy to see how well he coaches the best point guards and I'm truly blessed to be one of them. He is a great person more than he is a great coach.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on building chemistry with Tyrese Maxey
quotes.excerpt: Max is similar to Sabonis as far as the touch around the rim.
quotes.quote: Max is similar to Sabonis as far as the touch around the rim. They both can pass. Building chemistry with Max all summer has been great for sure. It's going to be good throughout the year and I can't wait to get it started.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on receiving advice from veteran teammates
quotes.excerpt: Malik hit me when I first got drafted, Zach hit me when I first got drafted.
quotes.quote: They all gave me advice. Malik hit me when I first got drafted, Zach hit me when I first got drafted. All of them. Effort Payton, it's been good to have him here. Everybody, we all been talking to each other and getting advice from guys you watched on TV is the greatest thing for sure.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on the transition from college to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: In college it's more team, it's more on schedule here.
quotes.quote: It's way different. You more of a man now, you on your own timing. You got to get your own work in. In college it's more team, it's more on schedule here. It's kind of the same but you got to get your own timing, your own thing, your own workout schedule.
